name: web-royal-blue-and-lime-supplement-landing-page
title: Men's supplement landing page in royal blue, lime and off-white
whatItIs: A long landing page with a lime ticker at the top, minimal nav, a hero of a big black-and-blue headline 'OWN YOUR ENERGY.' next to a product bottle and box, a two-part card with a huge numeral 02 and a blue formula panel of stat chips, four feature cards (one blue, one lime), a black ritual section, lime testimonial, product buy box, FAQ, blue CTA and dark footer.
whatItMeans: Confident, clinical and energetic; strong colour blocks feel like sports performance.
techniques: Set headlines in heavy grotesque caps with one blue word.
Pair a huge numeral with a small caption for a stat moment.
Alternate cream, blue, lime and black full-width bands.
Use a blue product box to echo the palette in the hero.
Present features as numbered cards with lime highlights.

vocabulary.definition: A full-width section in one solid colour.
A scrolling top bar of short claims.
A giant number as a design element.
The purchase panel with price and options.
